The receptionist is incredibly rude and has given me bad advice on several occasions. She referred me to a telephone appointment several times for the GP to say I should have an in person appointment. Then when trying to make appointments, she insists they can only be made on the day at 8am. When I need the GP, sitting on the phone at 8am for 30+ min is an impossible task. She refuses to make appointments for any other day. My needs are not urgent for same day. It would be better for my health and safety to be seen on a day that suits my symptoms. There was a communication breakdown between the GP and Chemist. My prescription hadn't been received. I was told to visit the Reception to resolve the problem. At 0900 i joined two men in the queue at the Reception. One guy said he had pressed the button 3 times and no answer. I pressed the button twice after waiting ten minutes and still.no answer. The two men decided enough was enough and left the premises in disgust. I was then joined by an elderly lady  on crutches and I advised her due to the delay it maybe advisable to take a seat. I had waited 25 minutes. So I pressed the request button again and was joined by a female who apologised for the delay, claiming staff were on the phone.
